verdict.rationale: Box documents a public REST API at https://api.box.com/2.0 with OAuth 2.0 auth, a reference with a runnable curl example, and getting-started steps for a developer token and first call. Guides cover uploads, shared links, collaborations, search, metadata, events, webhooks, Box AI and Box Sign, and an llms.txt index exists. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths (all returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
